name: summer-cafe-black-sporty-fashion
image_purpose: Instagram carousel or lifestyle fashion grid

prompt.project_info: Create a clean four-panel lifestyle fashion collage of an approved adult woman enjoying a green iced drink along a modern outdoor cafe walkway.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with long loose hair and relaxed, confident, smiling, and neutral expressions across the panels. She wears the reference's black athletic set, black sneakers and socks, black shoulder bag, and minimal jewelry with safe coverage and natural proportions.
prompt.composition_elements: 2x2 grid of portrait panels: casual standing, leaning against a planter, smiling with the drink, and comfortable crouching pose. Keep the subject centered in each frame with consistent scale, outfit, bag, drink, and background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with soft shadows under a white modern pergola, lush green plants and vines, pale stone tile, fresh summer atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Lifestyle fashion photography, portrait panels combined into a vertical collage, 50mm look, moderate depth of field, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, clean realistic color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clean 2x2 grid collage of one approved adult blonde woman with long loose hair enjoying a green iced drink along a modern outdoor cafe walkway. Across four portrait panels she stands casually, leans against a planter, smiles while holding the clear cup with straw, and crouches comfortably. She wears the reference's black athletic set with safe coverage, black sneakers and socks, black shoulder bag, and minimal jewelry. White modern building with pergola, lush green plants and vines, pale stone tile, natural daylight with soft shadows, fresh healthy stylish summer lifestyle, consistent subject scale, outfit, bag, drink, and background across all panels, realistic skin texture, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, childlike appearance, distorted hands, extra fingers, inconsistent outfit, duplicate subject, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random logos, low resolution, blur

assets.name: summer-cafe-black-sporty-fashion.jpg
assets.usage: Use for adult subject, black athletic outfit, drink, four-panel poses, cafe walkway, plants, architecture, and collage layout.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve approved adult identity, exact black outfit, drink, bag, four-panel layout, cafe architecture, and consistent styling. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult or cafe variation while retaining the same grid logic. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
